name: smwsprites-level-ender-v1
title: Level Ender v1.1
description:
This sprite will cause the level to end when all the enemies on screen are killed. This version ignores sprites that don't turn into a coin when the goal tape is passed.

Uses extra bit: YES
When the extra bit is clear, the sprite will trigger the regular exit. When it is set, the sprite will trigger the secret exit.

Read the readme if you want to use secret exit + no walk config.

Extra property byte 1: if 0, Mario will freeze when the level ends.

Extra property byte 2: it's the song number that plays at the level end. Change from C to 3 if using AddmusicK.

v1.1
-----
Added a readme about secret exits. They only work if you allow the player to walk. This is an in-game piece of code, if you wanna change this behaviour, read the readme.
Fixed a bug with setting up secret exits.
